question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**was**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "It (4)______ thoroughly inspected on the day of its fatal voyage" requires the correct past tense passive form of the verb "inspect."
 
• "Was" is the correct auxiliary verb for simple past passive voice, fitting the sentence structure "was thoroughly inspected."
 
• "Has been" is present perfect passive, which is not suitable since the event happened in the past at a specific time.
 
• "Was been" is grammatically incorrect and does not exist in English.
 
• "Have been" is present perfect plural and incorrect here because the subject is singular ("It").

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Naval architects never claim that a ship is unsinkable, but the sinking of the passenger-and-car ferry Estonia in__ the Baltic surely **__should__ never have happened. It was well designed and **__carefully__ maintained. It carried the proper number of lifeboats. It **__was__** thoroughly inspected on the day of its fatal voyage. Yet hours later, the Estonia rolled over and (5) _______ in a cold and stormy night.*
